candidate_space: WO2018173768-inspired PPG/4,4-MDI constrained grid (PUR_SIM_V1, synthetic; 58 blends x 16 NCO:OH points = 928 candidates)

layers.L0_property: argmin property_score over all candidates, no constraints
layers.L1_constrained: argmin property_score over candidates passing every hard_constraints gate (identical to PUR-ORACLE V2)
layers.L2_robust: argmin robust_score over L1-feasible candidates that also pass the robustness gates

robustness.definition: robust_score = sum_k w_k * (|log10(y_k / c_k)| + r)^2, where r is the frozen log10 interval radius of the candidate; worst case of the nominal objective over the uncertainty interval
robustness.rationale: Uncertainty is propagated as a deterministic interval, not a distribution. A candidate is robust-feasible only if every response stays inside the preferred window over its whole interval and its chemistry-domain distance does not exceed the in-domain reference.

backward.manifold: mdi_parts = k_blend * nco_oh (exact on the frozen grid)

local_trends.evaluated_at: robust_winner (falls back to constrained_winner if the robust layer is not frozen)
local_trends.nco_axis: increasing NCO:OH along the same blend
local_trends.composition_axis: increasing parts of the higher-MDI-demand component within the same two-component family at fixed NCO:OH

expected_from_docs.note: Values stated in project documentation before this freeze. The freeze script reports any disagreement; it never edits data to match.
